subject: general
question:
The given Venn diagram shows the number of students who got distinction in three subjects among 350 students. Find the percentage of students who got distinction in only two subjects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a337fe19e26a9c6db13d7ac803e3c64b6e7a8e5dff964258729ef78de4877e39.png]
solution:
Here, the number of the students who got distinction in only subjects are as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a337fe19e26a9c6db13d7ac803e3c64b6e7a8e5dff964258729ef78de4877e39.png] 

Total number of students = 350

English and Physics = 25

Physics and Hindi = 10

English and Hindi = 35

Total number of students who got distinction in 2 subjects = 25 + 10 + 35 = 70

Percentage of students who got distinction in only 2 subjects = (70 ÷ 350 ) × 100

 = 0.2 × 100 =** 20%**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(2)**
